messages.text: The screenshots show the intended hierarchy and masonry behavior on both widths, with the mobile dock remaining clear and the preview fitting without clipped copy. The production preview attempt failed because the Windows command wrapper exited before readiness, not because the built app failed; I’m restarting the built output through the exact Node/Vite process so its PID remains trackable, then probing storefront, detail, and analytics routes.

commands.commandLine: {"command":"New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force .tura/logs | Out-Null; $out=(Resolve-Path .tura/logs).Path+'\\preview.stdout.log'; $err=(Resolve-Path .tura/logs).Path+'\\preview.stderr.log'; $vite=(Resolve-Path node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js).Path; $p=Start-Process -FilePath (Get-Command node).Source -ArgumentList @($vite,'preview','--host','127.0.0.1','--port','3200') -WorkingDirectory (Get-Location).Path -RedirectStandardOutput $out -RedirectStandardError $err -PassThru; Set-Content .tura/preview.pid $p.Id; $ready=$false; for($i=0;$i -lt 40;$i++){Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 500;$p.Refresh();if($p.HasExited){Write-Error \"Preview exited $($p.ExitCode): $(Get-Content $err -Tail 20)\";exit 1};try{$r=Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing http://127.0.0.1:3200 -TimeoutSec 2;if($r.StatusCode -eq 200){$ready=$true;break}}catch{}};if(-not $ready){Stop-Process -Id $p.Id -Force;Write-Error \"Preview readiness timeout: $(Get-Content $err -Tail 20)\";exit 1};\"Preview ready at http://127.0.0.1:3200 (PID $($p.Id))\"","workdir":"C:\\Users\\liuliu\\Documents\\tura-benchmark\\raw\\project-rebuild-makeup-tanstack-fullstack\\g56-fs-td2-20260710b\\projects\\makeup-tura-direct","timeout_ms":30000}
commands.preview: New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force .tura/logs | Out-Null; $out=(Resolve-Path .tura/logs).Path+'\preview.stdout.log'; $err=(Resolve-Path .tura/logs).Path+'\preview.stderr.log'; $vite=(Resolve-Path node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js).Path; $p=Start-Process -FilePath (Get-Command node).Source -ArgumentList @($vite,'preview','--host','127.0.0.1','--port','3200') -WorkingDirectory (Get-Location).Path -RedirectStandardOutput $out -RedirectStandardError $err -PassThru; Set-Content .tura/preview.pid $p.Id; $ready=$false; for($i=0;$i -lt 40;$i++){Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 500;$p.Refresh();if($p.HasExited){Write-Error "Preview exited $($p.ExitCode): $(Get-Content $err -Tail 20)";exit 1};try{$r=Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing http://127.0.0.1:3200 -TimeoutSec 2;if($r.StatusCode -eq 200){$ready=$true;break}}catch{}};if(-not $ready){Stop-Process -Id $p.Id -Force;Write-Error "Preview readiness timeout: $(Get-Content $err -Tail 20)";exit 1};"Preview ready at http://127.0.0.1:3200 (PID $($p.Id))"
